info.title: identity service
info.description:
Accounts, sign-in, tokens and account deletion. Owns schema `identity`.

Access tokens are JWTs signed with the key published at `/.well-known/jwks.json`.
Claims: `sub` (user id), `role` (`user` | `admin`), `iss`, `aud`, `iat`, `exp`, `jti`.
Refresh tokens are opaque random strings sent only in the `refresh_token` cookie
(`HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth`); the database stores their SHA-256.

`x-access` on each operation is the access level at the gateway (`public`, `user`, `admin`;
`internal` = not routed). `x-rate-limit` is the per-minute limit at the gateway.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description:
Request correlation id. The gateway creates one (UUID) when the client sends none and
forwards it; every service logs it, returns it and passes it on.

password.description: Plain password in the request only; hashed with Argon2id, never stored or logged.

201.description: Account created. The user signs in with `/auth/login`.

Location.description: URL of the created or running resource.

400.description: The request is malformed or fails schema validation.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation id of the request (received or generated).

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new pair (rotation)
post.description:
The presented token is revoked and replaced. Presenting a token that was already
replaced is treated as theft: every session of the user is revoked and `401` is returned.
